description:
Run a 24/7 live stream of pre-recorded videos, or live stream one recorded video at the time you choose, from ChatGPT. Your old videos, lessons, podcast episodes or lofi beats play as one continuous livestream, looped from a playlist in the order you choose. LiveReacting's servers do the streaming, so your computer can be off.

With this plugin you build the stream from your LiveReacting video library, multistream it to YouTube, Facebook, Twitch or any other platform, schedule it to go live later, change the playlist while it is live, and check how it is running. Streams you built in LiveReacting with overlays, polls or trivia start from here too.

You need a LiveReacting account that includes API access. Connect your channels once in LiveReacting, and the plugin uses them. Videos come from your library, a direct link, Google Drive, Dropbox, or videos you already published on your own YouTube channel.

defaultPrompt: Loop the videos from my LiveReacting library as a 24/7 live stream on my YouTube channel
Live stream my recorded video from Google Drive on my Facebook page today at 8 PM
Show the status of my running live streams
